correctness.rationale: Each of the sixteen blowup-curve classes has the exact intersection rules recorded in RESULT.md, giving a stable 40-node graph of genus 25. A Frobenius-fixed conic splits the degree map; the graph monodromy pairing identifies fixed groups with the dual coinvariants. Seven rooted integral orbit-Laplacian matrices have exact determinants 2^31, 2^22, 2^17, 2^13, 2^8, 2^8 and 2^3; separate two-adic Smith reductions give the listed invariant factors. The standalone checker reproduces those calculations. The Neron claim is conditional on a proper regular unit-thickness smoothing.

value.rationale: The complete sixteen-curve divisor is a canonical genus-25 stable boundary of a degree-four del Pezzo surface. Its finite-field rational Neron component group is an intrinsic arithmetic degeneration invariant. Seven classes provide a natural complete classification for five-point permutation twists; the two nonisomorphic order-256 structures demonstrate information finer than component counts or group order. This is not a routine consequence of the known abstract split critical group.
